description: Plays pleasant sounds for progress bars instead of NVDA's beeps: 14 built-in sounds, or your own WAV files. Choose separate sounds for the start, halfway point and end of a progress bar, let the pitch rise and the sound move from left to right as progress goes up, and hear an announcement such as "Download complete" when a progress bar finishes. Settings are in NVDA menu, Preferences, Settings, Progress Pulse.
